title: Research@ 2026: Novel capabilities and intelligence
gist: Google Research's Research@ 2026 event roundup is a link hub to announcements: Deep Review launching publicly after use on 15,000+ conference submissions, an AMIE primary-care study in The Lancet, Google Earth AI for public health, a Geospatial Reasoning agent, and Project Suncatcher for AI in space. The post itself gives little detail beyond headlines.

insights.claim: Google's Deep Review tool for analyzing technical documents is launching publicly after successful deployments across more than 15,000 submissions at STOC, ICML, NeurIPS and ICLR.
insights.speaker: Google Research
insights.so_what: AI-assisted peer review is moving into mainstream academic workflows; watch conference policies on AI review.
insights.locator: Analyzing technical documents with Deep Review

insights.claim: Google Research has evolved a Geospatial Reasoning agent from an early concept into a much more capable but still experimental system aimed at the planet's biggest challenges.
insights.speaker: Google Research
insights.so_what: Google is extending agentic AI to geospatial analysis, relevant to climate, insurance and logistics data users.
insights.locator: AI agents for our planet's biggest challenges

insights.claim: A peer-reviewed study in The Lancet evaluates Google's AMIE medical AI in a real-world primary care clinic, with Google framing the finding as AI possibly aiding patient-doctor relationships.
insights.speaker: Google Research
insights.so_what: Peer-reviewed clinical evidence strengthens the case for medical AI deployment and regulatory acceptance; details of results are not in this post.

insights.claim: Google's science AI model was the best at forecasting flu-related hospital admissions, as announced by the Centers for Disease Control.
insights.speaker: Google Research
insights.so_what: Government benchmark wins support Google's public-health AI credibility; note the claim is Google's own summary.
insights.locator: Google's AI ranks #1 for predicting flu hospitalizations

insights.claim: Google Earth AI's Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) is aimed at the data gaps and temporal reporting lags of existing epidemiological workflows, helping public health leaders forecast outbreaks.
insights.speaker: Google Research
insights.so_what: Geospatial foundation models are being positioned as infrastructure for public-health forecasting.
insights.locator: Unlocking Earth AI's planetary geospatial foundation models

insights.claim: Project Suncatcher is Google's moonshot to put AI in space, with work on testing hardware survival in space and designing cooling systems for AI chips.
insights.speaker: Google Research
insights.so_what: Space-based AI compute is an early-stage bet on escaping terrestrial power and cooling limits; watch for hardware test milestones.
insights.locator: Project Suncatcher, our moonshot to put AI in space
